top_choice_rationale: The magic-wavelength lattice is a clean, quantitative idea (vanishing differential light shift, no Doppler or recoil shifts, many atoms) that has been rebuilt independently at RIKEN/Tokyo, JILA, PTB, SYRTE and NIST and compared at the 1e-18 level with understood uncertainty budgets. That is the independent confirmation I require. Credit to Katori (concept, first Sr demonstrations) and Ye (accuracy and stability frontier) is compact and fits a single-part prize. My residual reservation is that this is a measurement achievement with null fundamental-physics bounds so far, and the citation must stay on the lattice invention, not on clocks or combs generally, but that does not outweigh awarding a mature, verified achievement over no award.
